dogecoin.text:
Cryptos making big moves:

- Uniswap (UNI). The DeFi industry may have been squished by a Harris government, so huge rise in UNI.

- Dogecoin (DOGE). Musk is a big fan. He says he'll set up a Department of Government Efficiency (D.O.G.E.) It's government by meme now!

@adrianbold IF (a massive if) DOGE were ever to become the currency of the internet or the universe or whatever, I expect Elon would ensure the Dogecoin Foundation tweaked the code to restrict supply.
